description: Local corrections for known wrong CVE mappings in the upstream database

corrections.reason: CVE-2024-1733 belongs to word-replacer-ultra (Word Replacer Pro), not wordfence

corrections.title: word_replacer_pro: CVE-2024-1733
corrections.description: The Word Replacer Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data due to a missing capability check on the word_replacer_ultra() function in all versions up to, and including, 1.0. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to update arbitrary content on the affected WordPress site.
corrections.remediation: Update the plugin/theme to the latest version.
